Man arrested for allegedly killing live-in partner in separate incidents

A man has been arrested in connection with the alleged killing of his live-in partner. In Keralam, a man was arrested for allegedly setting his partner on fire in Ernakulam. Separately, in Gurugram, a man was arrested for allegedly bludgeoning his live-in partner to death following an argument.
